_doc: Drives portfolio-gate's voice memory-loop probe in CI. No toolSecretHeader override: Kira uses the package's canonical x-convai-tool-secret. It previously named a Kira-local header — a fork of a portfolio-wide mechanism, and one that had forced the SHARED probe to grow this option purely to accommodate one repo. Migration completed 2026-07-26: prod deployed dual-accept, all 13 operational agents were re-provisioned onto the canonical header (verified 13/13, 0 legacy), the live probe passed 5/5 on the canonical header alone, and only then was the legacy path removed. The option remains in portfolio-gate for products that genuinely need a different name.
